text: Implemented robust-triggered AR re-estimation as a typed RobustAutocorrelation policy on RobustLeastSquares. Robust fits now estimate a shared/run-pooled AR whitening plan from robust residuals, carry AR diagnostics through DenseFitBlockResult, and prepared chunk execution reuses the full-selection whitening plan plus row-wise robust weights. Voxelwise robust AR is rejected explicitly until per-voxel robust covariance bundles exist. Added model validation coverage, kernel diagnostics coverage, and future-chunked robust AR equivalence coverage. Evidence: sbt modelJVM/test passed 15; sbt fitJVM/test passed 113; sbt modelJS/test passed 15; sbt fitJS/test passed 110; tracked diff check clean; direct trailing-whitespace check clean for untracked fit files.
